Description.description: Legal matters and cases in Spaarke. A Matter is the primary organizing entity - it contains Projects, Events aka tasks and deadlines, Documents, and Parties. When users ask about 'matters', 'cases', 'litigation', or 'deals', query this table. Matters have a name, status, type such as litigation, transactional, or advisory, responsible attorney, and client. Related entities: sprk_project workstreams within a matter, sprk_event for tasks and deadlines, sprk_document for files and contracts.
